name: The Powder Toy
description: Updater writes downloaded bytes over the running exe then ShellExecutes it (4-byte magic only). Separately, installScriptManager auto-runs unsigned Lua from a 3rd-party domain.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The updater accepts a format/magic check and decompresses the payload before handing it to Platform::UpdateStart; no cryptographic signature is checked.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.
